product.title: Monterey Bay Sailing Cruise

description.text: Sail Monterey Bay on a one- or two-hour catamaran cruise from Old Fisherman's Wharf. Watch for whales, dolphins, sea otters, and sea lions while enjoying views of the golden hills surrounding the protected marine sanctuary.

highlights: Sailing cruise on Monterey Bay from Fisherman's Wharf
Watch for whales, dolphins, and sea otters
Views of sanctuary hills and coastline

start.description: Meet at Monterey Bay Sailing, 78 Old Fisherman's Wharf #1, Monterey, CA 93940.

end.description: Return to Old Fisherman's Wharf after the sailing loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Sail Monterey Bay on a one- or two-hour catamaran cruise from Old Fisherman's Wharf.

itineraryItems.title: Old Fisherman's Wharf
itineraryItems.description: Board the catamaran at the Sail Monterey office on Fisherman's Wharf.

itineraryItems.title: Monterey Bay
itineraryItems.description: Sail sanctuary waters with views of marine wildlife and coastal hills.

itineraryItems.title: Cannery Row
itineraryItems.description: Pass Cannery Row shoreline from open-water perspectives on the return leg.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Monterey Bay Sailing Cruise?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 1 to 2 hours.

faqs.answer: Meet at Monterey Bay Sailing, 78 Old Fisherman's Wharf #1, Monterey, CA 93940.
